title: QA run · milestone:#35880 (16/18) · 305fe60e · 2026-11-24 · 11 PASS / 5 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 2 NOT-RUN
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Milestone acceptance on main for epic #35880 (all children closed; #34632 D2-A signal ②; the maintainer's 2026-11-24 direction to test on main, not on a release). Filed by the seat from runner `session_01QSeKYovgsV1kRipHwyurD8`'s report (Sonnet orchestrator with Sonnet helpers); the runner made no GitHub write.

## Environment
- **Subject:** `origin/main` at `305fe60e6e97`, checked out detached; `ui/` built from the same tree. Node v22.23.5.
- **Build:** `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 21 s, `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 14m58s, `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` was a cache hit plus copy. Setup ran 14:22:22Z to 14:37:49Z, 15m27s.
- **Showcase boot:** `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p 41801 -d file:/tmp/qa/run1/data.db`, with `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported. Signed in through the form as `admin@objectos.ai`, and as `phone.demo@example.com` for the single-app case.
- **Drivers:** Playwright Chromium with the named device `iPhone 13` (reported 390×664, no `deviceScaleFactor` set). Desktop at 1440×900 and one 820×1000 tablet run.
- **Judged on:** URL, network, DOM text and test ids only. No pixels.
- **Helpers:** none for this record. The one Sonnet subagent worked on record 2 only. Phone legs ran on one boot by one runner.

## Promises
Each is one acceptance line, in the epic's own words.
- **M1:** "登录后进应用": one app goes straight in; several apps and a previous one goes to the last-used app; several apps and a first login goes to the app list.
- **M2:** "应用首页就是全部菜单": grouped and ordered like the desktop sidebar; one tap goes to the object; "‹" returns with the scroll position kept.
- **M3:** "左上角是切换应用": the app pill opens a sheet with the current app, other apps and search.
- **M4:** "手机首页简化": the phone app home shows only the menu.
- **M5:** "底部固定:首页、通知、审批" plus a single round search, not per app, with no menu entries and no "More".
- **M6:** The bar's targets, the active cell and badges that aren't clipped. The bar is absent on list and record pages and returns on the way back.
- **M7:** The user-pinned bottom-menu entry is gone from settings.
- **M8:** List top row is back, object icon and name, More; no bell or avatar.
- **M9:** Toolbar is one row of pills (view name and count, sort, filter, search) with counts, the floating "+", and cards kept.
- **M10:** "点「✓」才生效" for sort: temporary, reload drops it, "×" discards.
- **M11:** Same for filter, including the empty-state "add filter".
- **M12:** View panel: current view ticked, a tap switches and closes, search present, a "View settings" entry.
- **M13:** "保存" menu: save to this view, save as my view (name defaults to "VIEW copy"), discard, a "saved" notice.
- **M14:** Selection: long-press or More then Select; a tap adds or removes; the "+" hides; the bar shows the count.
- **M15:** #36151 record page: the bottom bar appears only with the object's own actions; Edit moves into More; the approval case is unchanged.
- **M16:** Constraint: the phone panels share the desktop components, and any separate part is listed with a reason.
- **M17:** Desktop width unchanged.
- **M18:** On-screen keyboard inset, dark and light themes, an 8-character view name not truncated, and the 375-wide acceptance.

## Verdicts
Checklist mapping: no checklist item has a clause that tests any of these promises (phone files only matched incidental items), so every row below is "no checklist item", tested by hand.

| id | verdict | text evidence |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | PASS | First sign-in, 2 apps: URL `/_console/home`, text "Choose an app · Showcase · Setup". After opening Showcase, a fresh browser lands on `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase`. After `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_user_preference/ID` (key `ui.app.last`, value `["showcase_app"]`, 200) it lands on `/_console/home` again; picking Setup then re-login lands on `/apps/com.objectstack.setup`. `phone.demo` (one app) lands on the app menu (48 entries) and its switcher lists only "Showcase". Probe: a pref value of `ghost_app` falls back to the app list. |
| M2 | PARTIAL | `phone-app-home-menu` holds 59 entries; all 59 are in the desktop sidebar's 60, in the same relative order. Tapping "Accounts" goes to `/showcase_account`; back returns to the app root with scroll 400 before and after. Gap: I used browser back, not the "‹" button, and did not compare group headers. |
| M3 | PARTIAL | Pill opens `app-switcher-sheet`: "Switch Application · Current app · Showcase · Other apps · Setup · Close", and `phone-app-list-search` exists. Gap: picking a row from the sheet was not driven. |
| M4 | PASS | Strict text match on the phone app home for greeting, "Start from a template", AI card, recent and activity feed is false. |
| M5 | PASS | `phone-app-nav-cell` ×3 reads "Home", "Notifications 1", "Approvals 3". `phone-app-nav-search` ×1. The bar is `position:fixed` with bottom 664 = viewport 664. No "More" text. |
| M6 | PASS | Hrefs: app root, `…/sys_inbox_message?view=mine`, `…/system/approvals`. Tapping Approvals sets `aria-current` on `approvals` only. Both badges (16×16) sit inside the bar's box. On `/showcase_account` the bar count is 0; after back it is 1. |
| M7 | NOT-RUN | Settings page not opened. The phone menu and sheet show no pin controls (0 matches). |
| M8 | PASS | Visible header controls are "Back to the app menu", title "Tasks", and "More actions". Bell and command-palette nodes measure 0×0; no avatar. The object icon tile was not read. |
| M9 | PASS | `phone-list-toolbar` buttons: view switcher "All Tasks 10", Sort, Filter, Search. `scrollWidth` 390 equals `clientWidth` 390 and `documentElement.scrollWidth` 390. `mobile-fab-create` is fixed, 48×48. 10 `grid-mobile-card`. Count badges read "1" after apply. |
| M10 | PASS | Add sort Title desc: list order and requests unchanged before ✓. After ✓: `sort=-title`, first card "Warehouse schema", `phone-sort-chip-count` "1", Save visible. After reload: original order, chip empty, Save gone. "×" after adding a level: order and requests unchanged. ✓ with no change sends 0 non-GET requests. No reset row in the panel. Gap: drag reorder and the row ⋯ menu were not driven. |
| M11 | PASS | Empty panel: "No filter yet. Add one to show only the records that match." plus the add button. Status in-progress then ✓: count 10 to 2, request `filter=["status","=","in_progress"]`, chip "1". "×": count stays 10, no filter request. Gap: the advanced-OR notice was not driven. |
| M12 | PASS | `list-view-switcher-menu` lists the shared views plus "Add view", "Manage views" and "View settings". It has a search input and no ✓. Tapping "In Progress" switches to `/view/showcase_task.in_progress` ("2 records") and the panel closes. Gap: the View settings content was not opened. |
| M13 | PARTIAL | After a sort, the Save menu on a packaged view reads "Save as my view · Discard". Save-as defaults the name to "All Tasks copy". It writes `POST /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view` plus a preference PATCH, shows the "Saved" toast, Save disappears, and the chip count stays "1". On the new personal view the menu reads "Save to this view · Save as my view · Discard". Discard restores the order. Gap: the shared-view confirm and the "saved, visible to everyone" toast were not driven (the showcase's views are packaged and read-only). |
| M14 | PASS | More menu reads "Select · Import · Add to favorites". After Select, `floating-selection-bar` reads "0 selected"; after two card taps "2 selected Change Owner Delete" with the URL unchanged, and the "+" is hidden. Long-press (CDP touch, 900 ms) gives "1 selected Mark Done More", with a checkbox per card. Clear removes the bar and the "+" returns. |
| M15 | PARTIAL | Task record (authored actions): the one bar holds "Mark Done · Log Time" at y 608–652, and the More menu holds "Edit". Account record: no toolbar, More holds "Refresh · Edit · Share · Change Owner · Delete". Gap: the approval-pending record and a second-tap field edit were not driven. |
| M16 | PASS | PR #36024's "Shared with desktop" table names the shared pieces (`FilterPanel`, `SortPanel`, `FieldList`, `ObjectViewSwitcherMenu`, `ViewSettingsContent`, `ObjectViewMoreMenu`, `BulkActionBar`). Source imports in `PhoneListPanels.tsx` confirm `FieldList`, `FilterPanel` and `SortPanel`. Separate parts are listed with reasons, including `PhoneSortLevels`, kept apart from `SortBuilder` for bundle-size headroom. |
| M17 | PARTIAL | At 1440 the phone-only chrome (bottom bar, app home, toolbar) draws 0 nodes. The sidebar is present, the list is a 10-row grid, and `mobile-fab-create` is `display:none`. The record header shows "Edit". Gap: desktop landing is no longer unchanged, by design: since #36738/#36732 a desktop sign-in and `/_console/home` land in the last-used app (`…/page/showcase_capability_map`). The epic's text was overtaken. |
| M18 | NOT-RUN | Keyboard inset, dark and light themes, the 8-character view name and the 375-wide run were not driven. |

## Reproduction rules
None. There are no FAIL rows.

## Gap rules for the PARTIAL and NOT-RUN rows
- **M13, shared view:** save a sort to a view the signed-in user may edit. The menu should then offer a confirm and the "visible to everyone" toast.
- **M15, approval case:** open a record that has a pending approval for the signed-in position at phone width. The bottom bar should hold Approve and Reject, and there should be no second ⋯.
- **M18:** open the sort panel's field input and check the visual viewport inset; run light and dark; use a view named with 8 characters.

## Off-clause probes
About 8 minutes, as the admin and `phone.demo`.
- **Ran:** ✓ with no change; a stale last-app value; the record page at the same width.
- **Found:** nothing beyond the rows above.
- **Not run:** a recipients-outside-scope probe, since no notification surface was in scope.

## Acceptance reading
- **Met:** the maintainer-set structure (land in the app, menu as home, the three-cell bar, pill toolbar, ✓-applies panels). All 11 PASS rows are live phone behaviour.
- **Open items:** the shared-view Save and keyboard/theme legs. The epic's "desktop home unaffected" is superseded by #36738 on purpose.

### Setup versus test time (both records)
- **Setup:** 15m27s of build, on top of about 15 minutes of reading before it.
- **Test:** about 30 minutes of phone and desktop driving, plus the subagent's 50 minutes (20 of them its own setup) running in parallel.
- **Close-out:** the stop-and-confirm step was a few minutes.
